summary: A playable single-player Cipher Breach slice on the original Aperture Annex map: full buy/arm/defend/disarm round loop, economy, halftime and overtime, 12 weapons, 5 utilities, fog-of-war bots, and an authoritative 64 Hz room behind a validated protocol with prediction and lag compensation.
notes: Single human seat vs bots, no backend. three.js and DOM UI replace Babylon/React/Rapier/Colyseus. Screenshots rendered with software WebGL in headless Edge (real GPU fps and audio unverified). Dev URL ?dev=1&start=1&autoplay=1 drives the player seat with the bot brain.
